platform_model.name: Craftland Studio PC
platform_model.primary_scope: Broader visual scripting, code scripts/libraries, UI/resources, editor debugging, storage and tooling
platform_model.caution: Individual APIs can still be server-only, client-only, or otherwise platform-gated.

core_findings.summary: Visual block scripts respond to events and call available blocks/APIs; availability depends on script type/context.
Official PC manual describes .fcg code scripts, .fcc libraries, graph/function/event structure, imports, and static scripts.
Server and client scripts have distinct interfaces and communicate through events rather than direct calls.
Use one authoritative match-scoped counter in the server-side On Player Join handler and store the serial on the intended player; define reconnect semantics.
Official Data Storage guide describes normal player storage, ranking storage, statistics storage, operation limits, row/table caps, and archival use.
Newer Data Store API reference pages for WriteToDataStoreV2, ReadFromDataStoreSteady, and ReadFromDataStoreByColumn are labeled Server Side and Only PC; legacy WriteToDataStore is obsolete.
Timeline audio tracks, sound entities, and runtime sound APIs are different workflows; the track guide currently says custom audio import is not supported there and warns about overlapping keyframes.
A public older mirror of the Craftland Studio VS Code extension contains 42 .fcc libraries; a derivative parser index exposes enum/member/API/event/component candidates for discovery.
The 65 dropdown/type labels in Rough.txt have a structured crosswalk to mirrored library candidates and current official type references; 5 remain unresolved or legacy-review items.
Current official docs expose enum/type entries absent from the older library mirror, including RenderQualityType and dynamic skin/texture ID selector families.

All 42 public-mirror .fcc libraries were parsed for 681 function declarations, 259 events, and 470 component declarations with 3,219 candidate properties; metadata is secondary-source discovery only and must be checked against current Studio.
A normalized comparison of 443 extracted Rough.txt entries found 306 exact label/title matches to the old PC mirror, 113 approximate candidates, 21 unmatched lines, and 3 likely prose notes.
core_findings.confidence: derived-comparison; exact labels are not current compatibility proof

core_findings.summary: A public multilingual translated tutorial repo contains 160 Markdown manuals; its Mobile Block Script tutorial explicitly demonstrates Get Property (Player→Rig→Head), Set Property (Skeleton Scale), and Vector3 scale values, while its PC manuals explain .fcg/.fcc, EditorGenLib.fcc, server/client scripts, type/socket concepts and compile workflow.
core_findings.confidence: secondary-manual; source is older and repo has no license metadata; useful for examples, not current API authority

core_findings.summary: The public re-editable Game Mechanics template tutorial includes 13 reusable mechanism recipes, covering healing/damage zones, zombie spawning, traps, transfer, text, outfit changes, elevators, doors, global/player state, HUD and respawn behavior.
core_findings.confidence: secondary-manual recipe summaries; not runtime tested

core_findings.summary: Targeted current official pages resolve or normalize several Rough.txt names: Get Child By Index, Get Parent, Get Type Name, Filter Level Objects, Get global, This Entity, Wait for Millisecond and Global/portal events; other labels remain explicitly unresolved.
core_findings.confidence: official reference candidates; UI/API scope differences retained in per-entry notes

core_findings.summary: The 144 enum definitions in the public mirror include 42 groups of different type names sharing the exact same ordered member list; browsing can reuse one list while preserving each type's distinct identity.
core_findings.confidence: exact-set-compare-on-third-party-mirror; not an API equivalence guarantee

core_findings.summary: Official PC script manual points to the installed library path Craftland Studio/resources/LocalData/Utilities/UGCLanguage/release and explains EditorGenLib.fcc; official Studio 1.19.0 notes report an in-editor MCP server for Blocks, Scripts, Scenes, UI, Animation Controllers and more. These editor-local sources are the best remaining route to authoritative current lists.
core_findings.confidence: official documentation; local data has not yet been inspected in this chat

core_findings.summary: A community repository advertises a live Studio MCP catalog generator and self-reported inventory totals, but its inspected public commit does not publish the generated block/API records.

Garena documents Mobile block-script context, script types, classification/flow control, properties, data/logic and server/client concepts in a sequence of official pages; this guides verification but is not a complete dropdown dump.
Official Workflow documentation defines Phase and Round as entity/component types with indices and separate start/end events, not as an enum with a fixed member list.
The rough label `Loot Scorer Type` likely refers to official `LootSoccerType` / Loot Soccer Type, whose current official reference lists values 1040, 1038 and 1039.

A targeted official-doc cross-check records 367 visible option rows across 52 Rough.txt enum labels and flags differences from the older v1.5.0 mirror, including major VFX/Sound/Icon/Texture/Equipment/Player Pose/UI list-count mismatches; it remains partial, with no current-editor or Mobile parity/runtime testing inferred.

A community repo advertises a large live Craftland Studio MCP export, but its inspected public commit exposes only generator scripts and variables notes, not the generated per-item catalog or raw MCP responses.

Official Mobile docs cover block scripting, script/event types, flow control, variables/properties, data/logic and server/client scripts; they do not by themselves provide a complete machine-readable live block/dropdown catalog.

A targeted follow-up mapped ten previously unresolved Rough.txt labels to current official Items, AI and Property Formula API/event references; exact editor sockets and runtime behavior remain unverified.

After targeted official reference additions, 111 rough block lines remain as fuzzy candidates, old-mirror misses or a likely editor-native node; exact current editor sockets and runtime status remain separate verification tasks.
